resources.string: Maintains high-priority listening for payment receipt SMS.
Automated listener active for bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, and Cellfin receipts.

With your consent, GressPay Companion monitors incoming payment confirmation SMS for bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, and Cellfin. It parses sender rail, amount, and TrxID — personal messages and full inbox data are never uploaded or stored. Data is delivered securely over TLS to your GressPay platform to automate order settlements.
Toggle off matching or clear credentials at any time to immediately suspend automated sync.
